newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egyptian minister in talks with Palestinians.
newsitem.headline: Egyptian minister in talks with Palestinians.

text.p: Two senior Palestinian negotiators on Monday briefed Egyptian Foreign Minister Amr Moussa on their talks with Israel on the long-delayed pullback from the West Bank town of Hebron, ministry officials said.
They said Moussa met Hassan Asfour and Marwan Kanafani.
The men did not speak to reporters but Palestinian officials earlier reported unexpected progress in the Hebron talks.
A PLO official said Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu would join Israeli-Palestinian negotiations on Monday to try to close a deal.
Moussa was due to meet U.S. special envoy Dennis Ross later on Monday to discuss progress in the negotiations.
Palestinian officials said the U.S. team in the negotiations aimed to close a deal by Christmas.
